pane.title: hello
pane.content:
Welcome to ULTIMATE TUI.

This whole screen is one config file.

  arrows / tab    move focus
  enter           lock a pane, then j/k scroll
  esc             release  ·  F1  help
  F3              theme & style settings
  Ctrl+C          quit  (asks first)

Edit examples/hello.json and run it again.
